reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that aggregates local usage records and presents token, model, trend, activity, filtering, and export views; visualization is its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中汇总本地使用记录，并以图表和明细展示 Token、模型、趋势及活跃情况，支持筛选与 CSV/JSON 导出。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that summarizes local usage records with charts and details for tokens, models, trends, and activity, including filtering and CSV/JSON export.

capabilities: Reads local Harness session history to calculate usage statistics
Stores indexed statistics in local storage
Displays token, session, message, model, trend, and activity visualizations
Filters statistics by workspace and task
Exports statistics as CSV or JSON
